comment: Administrator username for the Model Gateway management interface.
Default: admin
Administrator API key for the Model Gateway management interface.
Optional — when set, this value is used verbatim as the apiKey in model-gateway-admins-secret.
When left blank, a cryptographically secure random 32-character key is auto-generated.
If provided, minimum 8 characters.
Example: MySecureAdminKey123
Set to true to deploy an IBM-managed CNPG (PostgreSQL) cluster for Model Gateway.
Set to false to connect Model Gateway to your own external PostgreSQL.
When true: HOSTNAME is auto-derived from the CNPG service FQDN.
USERNAME ('app') and PASSWORD are injected automatically at apply time.
When false: fill in HOSTNAME, PORT, DATABASE_NAME, USERNAME, PASSWORD below.
Default: false
PostgreSQL hostname for Model Gateway.
Only required when USE_IBM_CNPG=false (external / BYO PostgreSQL).
When USE_IBM_CNPG=true this is auto-derived from the CNPG service FQDN.
Example: my-postgres.example.com
PostgreSQL port for Model Gateway.
Default: 5432
PostgreSQL database name for Model Gateway.
Default: modelgateway
PostgreSQL username for Model Gateway.
Only required when USE_IBM_CNPG=false (external / BYO PostgreSQL).
When USE_IBM_CNPG=true the username is always 'app' — fixed by the CNPG operator,
not user-configurable.
PostgreSQL password for the Model Gateway database user.
Only required when USE_IBM_CNPG=false (external / BYO PostgreSQL).
When USE_IBM_CNPG=true this is auto-generated by CNPG at cluster init time and
injected into model-gateway-postgres-external-secret automatically at apply time.
Enable SSL for the Model Gateway PostgreSQL connection.
Only used when USE_IBM_CNPG=false.
When USE_IBM_CNPG=true SSL is always enabled (sslmode=verify-ca).
Default: false
SSL mode for the Model Gateway PostgreSQL connection.
Only used when USE_IBM_CNPG=false and SSL_ENABLED=true.
Valid values: require | verify-ca | verify-full
Place CA cert in ssl-certs/model-gateway/serverca/ for verify-ca or verify-full.
Place client cert+key in ssl-certs/model-gateway/clientcert/ and clientkey/ for mTLS.
Default: require
Number of PostgreSQL instances in the MG CNPG cluster (primary + replicas).
Only used when USE_IBM_CNPG=true.
Use 1 for development, 3 for production HA.
Default: 1
PVC storage size per PostgreSQL instance for Model Gateway.
Only used when USE_IBM_CNPG=true.
Default: 10Gi
Enable Redis caching for Model Gateway.
Automatically set to true when USE_IBM_REDIS=true.
Set to true manually if using an external Redis instance.
Default: false
Set to true to deploy an IBM-managed Redis instance in-cluster.
When true: IBM Redis CR + redispwdsecret + model-gateway-redis-external-secret are auto-generated.
Set to false to use your own external Redis — fill HOSTNAME, PORT, PASSWORD below.
Default: false
Redis hostname for Model Gateway.
Only required when USE_IBM_REDIS=false (external / BYO Redis).
When USE_IBM_REDIS=true this is auto-derived from the IBM Redis HAProxy service FQDN.
Example: my-redis.example.com
Redis port for Model Gateway.
Only required when USE_IBM_REDIS=false.
Default: 6379
Redis password for Model Gateway.
Only required when USE_IBM_REDIS=false.
When USE_IBM_REDIS=true this is auto-generated.
Set to true to connect to an external Redis over TLS (rediss://).
Only used when USE_IBM_REDIS=false.
When USE_IBM_REDIS=true TLS is always used (IBM Redis enforces it).
Default: false
